estimator_note: Weights apply within the California evaluation block only: design_weight expands the CA-pool frame of the frozen snapshot (pool_population works) and nothing outside it. The leak_test rows are purposive and carry no weight. Guide examples are excluded from every frame and split.
gold_labels_note: Gold labels were never merged into exports; only scripts/report_gold_status.py and the review app read the gold label sheet. This file was built without opening it (label_blind: true), so it records the design and pipeline state only.

weighting.design_weight: 1 / incl_prob (Horvitz-Thompson). Its expectation over seeds sums to pool_population; in a single sample it does not sum to it exactly
weighting.incl_prob: probability that a given work in a stratum is selected under the rule above; equal within a stratum
weighting.rule: sampling.build_split_rows round-robin: one work per stratum per round, in a seeded stratum order; the final round stops part-way through that order
weighting.within_stratum_fields: incl_prob_within_stratum = n_h / N_h and weight_within_stratum = N_h / n_h are conditional on the stratum being sampled; they sum to pool_population only when every stratum is sampled (500 of 873 are in this freeze)
